'''''Number Two''''', also referred to as the '''''Unit Two''''', was an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], it was sent to [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Freja Covell|Covell]], to attack the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Myrkr Base|base]] there. It served alongside other AT-ATs, like the ''[[Number Four]]'', and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]].
